aiSummary.oneLiner: A data aggregation tool for compiling and formatting open-graph metadata.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: This repository provides utilities for aggregating and standardizing open-graph metadata from various web sources. It fetches metadata such as titles, descriptions, and images to create rich link previews. The tool is designed to handle missing or malformed tags gracefully by employing fallback strategies. It outputs the aggregated data into structured formats like JSON for easy integration into other platforms. The project focuses on speed and reliability when crawling multiple URLs concurrently. It is highly useful for applications that rely heavily on generating accurate link previews.
keyFeatures: Metadata extraction: Scrapes open-graph tags and standard meta information from web pages.
Fallback mechanisms: Utilizes alternative data sources when primary open-graph tags are missing.
Concurrent fetching: Processes multiple URLs simultaneously for high-throughput aggregation.
Structured output: Formats the extracted data into clean, usable JSON structures.
Error handling: Manages timeouts and malformed HTML gracefully without crashing.
